import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_34/test_0.csv"
    ]

    # List to hold dataframes from all sources
    source_dfs = []

    # Load each source file, rename columns to match target schema, and append to list
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
        # Rename 'J_CALL' to 'V_GENE' to match target schema
        df_renamed = df.rename(columns={"J_CALL": "V_GENE"})
        source_dfs.append(df_renamed)

    # Concatenate all source dataframes (in this case only one)
    target_df = pd.concat(source_dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Optional: If needed, drop duplicates to match target unique examples count
    # The example shows 6583 tuples, which matches source count, so no deduplication needed
    # target_df = target_df.drop_duplicates()

    # Write the transformed dataframe to the target CSV file
    target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_34/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
